question: The present ages of P and Q are in the ratio 9 : 8 and after 2 years from now, they will be in the ratio 10 : 9. The present age of P is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present ratio = 9 : 8 → ages = 9x, 8x

After 2 years: (9x + 2) : (8x + 2) = 10 : 9

Cross multiply → 9(9x + 2) = 10(8x + 2)

81x + 18 = 80x + 20 → x = 2

**∴ P’s present age = 9x = 18 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present ratio = 9 : 8, future ratio = 10 : 9 after 2 years

**Formula used:**

Form equation using ratios

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present ages be 9x and 8x

⇒ After 2 years → (9x + 2)/(8x + 2) = 10/9

⇒ 9(9x + 2) = 10(8x + 2)

⇒ 81x + 18 = 80x + 20

⇒ x = 2

⇒ P’s age = 9x = 18

**∴ The present age of P is 18 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
